cases.task_text: Compare these supplied research abstracts: study A reports faster indexing but higher memory use; study B reports slower indexing and lower memory use. Summarize the tradeoff using only these excerpts.
cases.annotation_reason: Research can synthesize technical findings from supplied material; Document can compare the claims in supplied text. No external lookup is requested.

cases.task_text: Using only these supplied public API notes, compare option A's 100-request limit with option B's 200-request limit and summarize the documented difference for a technical reader.
cases.annotation_reason: Research can compare supplied technical information and Document can extract and compare the two supplied notes; neither needs an external source for this task.

cases.task_text: Inspect this supplied Python helper for a correctness issue and suggest a fix: def average(xs): return sum(xs) / len(xs). Consider an empty list.
cases.annotation_reason: Code can debug the supplied implementation; Review can identify the missing empty-input handling as a quality defect and recommend a correction.

cases.task_text: Assess this supplied handler and propose a concrete correction: function getUser(id) { return users[id].name; }. What happens when the ID is absent?
cases.annotation_reason: Code can explain the missing-ID failure and correction; Review can flag the same unhandled input as a defect in the supplied work product.

cases.task_text: A supplied report says January had 12 support tickets and February had 9. Extract the figures and state whether the report shows an increase or decrease.
cases.annotation_reason: Data can compare the supplied numeric values; Document can extract and compare the stated figures in the supplied report.

cases.task_text: From this supplied operations note, compare the stated error counts: Monday 8 and Tuesday 5. Identify which day has the larger count.
cases.annotation_reason: Data can compare the two structured counts; Document can extract and compare the explicit figures in the supplied note.

cases.task_text: Assess this supplied rollout plan and recommend a safer order: deploy the API, write rollback steps, then test a sample request.
cases.annotation_reason: Planning can reorder future work and dependencies; Review can critique the existing plan's deployment-before-validation risk and propose corrections.

cases.task_text: Evaluate this supplied migration checklist and suggest a better sequence: switch all clients, check compatibility, then prepare a fallback.
cases.annotation_reason: Planning can order the listed future steps by dependency; Review can identify the checklist's premature switch and missing preparation.

cases.task_text: Compare these supplied specification drafts and flag a conflict: draft A requires 30-day log retention; draft B requires 14-day retention for the same logs.
cases.annotation_reason: Document can compare the two supplied requirements; Review can identify their inconsistency as a draft-quality issue.

cases.task_text: Read these supplied API guide excerpts and identify a contradiction: one says requests must include X-Trace-ID; the other says the header is optional.
cases.annotation_reason: Document can compare the supplied guide statements; Review can flag the contradictory requirement and recommend clarification.

cases.task_text: Check this generated metric summary against supplied counts: 20 successes in 25 runs, described as a 90% success rate. State the correct rate and the error.
cases.annotation_reason: Data can recompute the rate from structured counts; Review can detect the unsupported percentage in generated output.

cases.task_text: Verify a supplied dashboard note: it calls a change from 40 to 50 requests a 50% increase. Calculate the actual increase and flag the claim if wrong.
cases.annotation_reason: Data can calculate the percentage change; Review can critique the inaccurate claim in a supplied work product.
